commits.summary: The default run builds Rust's tests in a lightly optimised profile and takes 3.4 minutes: the engine's own tests are several times faster for a build twice as long
commits.body: lib/Cargo.toml gains the profile test-fast (dev with its checks, opt-level 1, line tables only, the SAT solver at 3 as in dev), and test_costs.py run uses it for the default and unit tiers; the proof tier stays in release and plain cargo test stays dev, each in its own folder of target/. Measured on this machine on 2026-11-17, each binary alone: tests/alignment.rs 94 s as dev and 10 s in test-fast, summaries 13 s and 5 s, conformance 45 s and 36 s, application_core_joint 147 s and 123 s, integration and heap unchanged; the profile's first build 69 s, and a build after an edit in src/bmc/mod.rs 14 s where dev takes 7 s. The whole default run with it: 201 s, 49 of 49 passed, the Rust binaries 163 s of it (276 s and 230 s in the commit before). The job queued in the commit before, 20261117-003114, passed in 518 s on six CPUs without this profile, where the first job took 1170 s.
